body:
claire: Quick postmortem follow-up — storage surge noted recurring eviction pattern and inconsistent first-responder steps. Need concrete runbook edits and owners.

ben: I can take the triage checklist. I'll add exact PromQL, kubectl, and a short smoke test.

lee: I'll own the escalation matrix and alert ownership. Will confirm L2 backups and contact routing.

claire: Also want a small "recurring-patterns" appendix with mitigation plays (route to smaller-context model, run canary).

ben: Short canonical commands I'll put in the PR:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o wide
POD=$(kubectl get pods -n inference -l app=runtime -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
kubectl logs -n inference $POD --since=10m | egrep "evict|kv_warm|oom"
# promql: sum(rate(cache_eviction_total[1m])) and avg_over_time(kv_warmup_duration_seconds[5m])
```

lee: Please reference alerts: AlertCacheEvictionHigh and AlertKVWarmSlow. I'll map owners and tentative thresholds: eviction_rate > 2/min for 3m, kv_warmup_duration_seconds > 10s for 5m.

ops-bot: Linked postmortem: <https://redwood.internal/postmortems/storage-surge-19611>. Actions logged to INC-3247. Reminder set for 2026-03-31 09:00 UTC.

claire: Due dates: ben -> triage PR by 2026-04-02; lee -> escalation + owners by 2026-04-04; claire -> review thresholds by 2026-04-06.

ben: Opening PR today, will tag INC-3247 and include the routing play and smoke test.

lee: I'll update the alert dashboard and add the FAQ: "When to escalate for eviction spikes."

claire: Thanks — this thread is canonical for the runbook edits. Ping here for blockers.
